routes.name: bechuanaland_corridor
routes.rationale: Delayed Warren, Caprivi, response, and settlement handoffs reserve the single corridor-crisis state machine.
routes.destination_revalidation: Each destination rechecks the live corridor, required actor scopes, and the reserved route before acting.
routes.cancellation_handling: Invalid actors or territorial prerequisites route through the corridor cancellation or invalidation effects.
routes.idempotent_outcome: Global pending, active-war, victory, and resolved markers prevent duplicate launch or settlement.
routes.centralized_cleanup: sb_bechuanaland_cleanup_corridor_crisis owns terminal marker and participant cleanup.

routes.name: natalia_and_klip_river
routes.rationale: Delayed Klip consultations, retry-safe punitive and secession play receipts, exact-root outcome delivery, the exact Blood River launch retry, and Natalia follow-ups share one lifecycle.
routes.lease_marker: Klip launch leases, exact play/target/frozen-state evidence, pending/queued delivery receipts, Blood River bounded generation/queued plus paired launch/retry/lease/root markers, and Natalia consultation/story-war markers.
routes.destination_revalidation: Klip .050/.060 options recheck full launchability when held; .080/.081 require durable outcome evidence. Blood River .098 rechecks exact generation identity and permanent participant authority; .099 rechecks the live, independent, idle ZUL/ORA launch before retry. Other receipts recheck their surviving recipient and route state.
routes.cancellation_handling: Monthly Klip watchdogs requeue lost receipts, clean only permanently invalid participants, and preserve failed play attempts. Blood River uses a 730-day exact generation TTL plus hidden receipt and failed-create watchdogs: temporary war/play occupancy requeues, while death, retag, subject loss, or expired authority clears without reward. Other Natalia routes use their existing recovery paths.
routes.idempotent_outcome: Klip pending/queued/active/resolved/evidence markers, Blood River exact root/active markers, and Natalia result markers suppress duplicate launch, delivery, and settlement.
routes.centralized_cleanup: Klip route runtime/finalizers clear leases, exact-root state, evidence, and receipts at their terminal owner. Blood River clears assistance before symmetric exact identity cleanup; Natalia finalizers retain their existing cleanup.

routes.name: zululand_postwar_settlement_and_nieuwe_republiek
routes.rationale: The British handoff, Chiefdoms incidents and resolution, Nieuwe Republiek setup fallback and player handoff, imperial boundary confrontation, and reduced-republic union petition are one staged postwar settlement chain.
routes.lease_marker: Postwar handoff, Chiefdoms incident, claimant-fate, terminal-outcome, boundary-demand, defence-request, and union-petition markers reserve each delayed step.
routes.destination_revalidation: Each event rechecks its country, live subject or republic, territorial footprint, active situation, unresolved route, and any initiating scope before applying effects.
routes.cancellation_handling: The one-day NRP setup fallback finalizes a live republic or clears a failed creation lease; monthly housekeeping retries temporarily blocked handoffs and demands, lapses impossible boundary claims, and destroys the shared situation container after either terminal outcome.
routes.idempotent_outcome: Resolved, event-open, incident-fired, claimant-fate, boundary-response, cutback, and petition markers prevent duplicate choices or transfers.
routes.centralized_cleanup: The handoff finalizer, Chiefdoms cleanup, NRP setup finalizer, boundary response effects, and NRP monthly housekeeping own their respective leases, action costs, and terminal markers.

routes.name: boer_conventions_and_unions
routes.rationale: Courier-timed conventions, compact offers, appeals, and union responses are multi-country political chains.
routes.lease_marker: Feature-specific offer, appeal, claim, election, and pending-union variables
routes.destination_revalidation: Destination triggers recheck the relevant republic, leader, claim, relationship, and unresolved story state.
routes.cancellation_handling: Expired offers and invalid recipients terminate through the family monthly reconciliation paths.
routes.idempotent_outcome: Accepted/rejected/resolved markers and subject-state checks prevent repeated political settlement.
routes.centralized_cleanup: Each convention or union finalizer clears its offer and relationship markers.

routes.name: british_boer_subject_abolition
routes.rationale: A one-day notice applies Britain's slavery ban after Boer subjecthood has replaced any invalidated enforce-law war goal.
routes.lease_marker: Live British subjecthood together with an extant slavery law forms the transient delivery gate.
routes.destination_revalidation: The destination rechecks that the recipient remains a living Boer country, remains a British subject, and still permits slavery.
routes.cancellation_handling: If subjecthood ends or slavery is already banned before delivery, the event trigger cancels the notice without side effects.
routes.idempotent_outcome: Activating Slavery Banned makes the route ineligible for any later duplicate subject callback.
routes.centralized_cleanup: The law transition itself clears eligibility; this route creates no auxiliary variables or scopes.

routes.name: scripted_frontier_wars
routes.rationale: Delayed war windows and diplomatic notices reserve retryable scripted-war state.
routes.lease_marker: War-family scheduled, pending, active-play, and resolved variables
routes.destination_revalidation: Launch events recheck truces, participants, territorial targets, peace, and committed-play status.
routes.cancellation_handling: Failed launches remain retryable or are cleared when the historical target ceases to exist.
routes.idempotent_outcome: Resolved markers are written only after a matching play starts or a terminal no-target condition is proven.
routes.centralized_cleanup: War-end and family monthly handlers clear temporary setup and modifier state.

routes.name: diamond_and_griqualand
routes.rationale: Delayed claimant correspondence, annexation results, and the hidden sequential Phase-B launcher form the Kimberley and Griqualand settlement chains.
routes.lease_marker: Kimberley discovery/resolution, claimant-route and demand markers, plus the named sequence container and Phase-B/event-pending leases
routes.destination_revalidation: Receipt events validate the claimant, local authority, CAP relationship, unresolved diamond route, surviving legal claim count, WBL independence, and current Griqualand West owner before Phase B.
routes.cancellation_handling: Fallback events settle missing claimants and invalid authorities; hidden .261 retries and the monthly watchdog recover interrupted Phase B, while zero/two-claim terminal states close without another play.
routes.idempotent_outcome: Discovery, route, demand, phase-transition, sequence-resolved, and finalization markers prevent duplicate mines, claims, diplomatic plays, and subject changes.
routes.centralized_cleanup: Shared Griqualand finalizers clear temporary scopes, play leases, event-pending state, and sequence markers before marking the diamond arc resolved.

routes.name: namibia_expedition
routes.rationale: Mission incidents, German intelligence, expedition outcomes, and SWA setup are driven by one expedition lifecycle.
routes.lease_marker: je_sb_map_namibian_coast plus expedition active, incident, cooldown, and outcome variables
routes.destination_revalidation: Incident and outcome events require the expedition JE, valid commander, and continuing eligibility.
routes.cancellation_handling: Default, lost law or interest, subjecthood, and occupied beachheads invoke expedition failure cleanup.
routes.idempotent_outcome: Success/failure markers and beachhead ownership prevent duplicate transfers and rewards.
routes.centralized_cleanup: The expedition finish effects remove costs, commander state, progress variables, and competing missions.

routes.name: imperial_confederation_and_delagoa
routes.rationale: Delayed imperial demands and Delagoa notifications bridge international-situation state between countries.
routes.lease_marker: Imperial Confederation and Delagoa open/resolved/demand markers
routes.destination_revalidation: Destination events recheck the live situation, market/port route, and required countries.
routes.cancellation_handling: Invalidated situations close through their existing monthly or terminal cleanup effects.
routes.idempotent_outcome: Open, completed, failed, and demand markers suppress duplicate international-situation outcomes.
routes.centralized_cleanup: Each international situation owns one close/finalization effect for its markers and modifiers.

routes.name: anglo_zulu_exact_annex_finalizer
routes.rationale: A one-day retry invokes only the saved exact British-Zulu annex play finalizer while its pending marker, exact play scope, and mutually exclusive route marker remain bound; the centralized finalizer revalidates physical annex evidence and is idempotent.

routes.name: rhodesian_venture_charter_finalizer
routes.rationale: A one-day engine boundary lets BSA finish country creation before BSAC is created and configured synchronously with its headquarters, charter territory, asset, and executive.

routes.name: self_contained_story_dispatches
routes.rationale: These are self-contained story notifications, choices, or same-feature follow-ups. They reserve no external diplomatic-play or subject-state transaction between dispatch and receipt; their event triggers may safely suppress an obsolete notice.
